setting: You both live in Melbourne, Australia, and you were together for about six years before splitting up last spring, so you know each other's habits well. You still share a lot of mutual friends and have been handling the cat, Biscuit, between you since moving out, and last time you messaged you swapped notes on a cricket score and nothing more.
opener: Ask whether Dan can take Biscuit for the weekend, since her shifts make it hard.

Jess.who: 36, woman, the ex who first moved out of the shared flat
Jess.knows: You know Dan as your ex-partner of six years, the one who is steady and kind but forgets vet appointments and sends the wrong food.
Jess.like: You are practical, dry and a bit impatient with vague plans, but you have a quick, self-deprecating humour. You care a lot about Biscuit and you get on with Dan well enough, though you tease him about his cooking and sometimes lose patience when he doesn't follow through.
Jess.texts: You message now and then without being asked, mostly to sort out logistics.
Jess.style: You type in short lowercase lines, use the occasional full stop, and rarely use emoji.

Dan.who: 38, man, the ex who kept the flat and the cat
Dan.knows: You know Jess as your ex-partner of six years, the person who is organised and quick to make decisions, and who you still care about.
Dan.like: You are easygoing, warm and a bit scattered, with a sense of humour that runs to puns and sly jokes. You are passionate about live music and cooking, and you get on with Jess by trying to keep things friendly, though you sometimes dodge her more direct questions.
Dan.texts: You message now and then without being asked, usually when you are thinking about Biscuit.
Dan.style: You write in mostly complete sentences with normal capitals, and you use the occasional emoji or a laughing face when something amuses you.

private_lines.Jess: You live in a small rented flat in Fitzroy and work as a pharmacist on rotating shifts. This week you are busy with a few long shifts and a lease renewal you have to sign by Friday.
private_lines.Dan: You live in Brunswick in a share house with two others and work as a sound technician for a theatre company. This week you have late rehearsals and a show opening on Saturday, so your evenings are unpredictable.

situation: My ex and I, sorting out who keeps the cat.

text: dan can you take biscuit this weekend. i've got shifts sat and sun and can't do the litter/feeds properly
Oh hey! Yeah I think so, when are you dropping her off? Sat morning?
sat 8am at the latest. i'm on at 9 sun so you'd have to do sunday too
Yep fine by me. Sunday night she comes back to you?
yes. she needs her wet food at 7 not whenever you feel like it
Ha, I did once and you never let it go 😂
because you gave her the wrong one and she spent the night being sick on the rug
Fair. I've learnt. Mostly
mostly is not great dan
Noted 🙂 I've got rehearsals late all week so if I'm not around on Sat morning can I give you a key code thing or do you need to be there
i'll be there at 8 i'll wait til you're up. you're not up at 8 are you
Usually not, no 😅 I'll set an alarm. Promise
ok. don't make me come round and wake you
Wouldn't dream of it
did the lease renewal come through to you yet or is it just me
Not yet, but I haven't checked the post since Friday. Have you got the terms?
its on the agent portal. have to sign by friday or they put the rent up. i'll sign tonight after shift
Good luck with that, sounds like a lot of paperwork
just got off. remind me what time the vet is on sat
I don't think there's a vet thing this weekend? Is she due?
her booster was meant to be last month. i booked it for mon 4th and you didn't come
Oh no. Sorry Jess. I'll check my calendar tonight
it's not a massive deal she's fine. just get the date right on your end
Will do. Biscuit is going to get the best weekend ever though, I'm planning tuna
no tuna. she gets the wet food at 7. that's it
Checked. Vet's in my phone as Mon 4th at 10? Is that right
yes 4th at 10. i booked it. you were supposed to be there
Yeah. Got it. Sorry again
Can you forward me the confirmation? I want it in the shared calendar so it's not just in my head
forwarded. signed the lease btw. rent's up 3% anyway
Congrats?? Or commiserations
commiserations. it's fitzroy
Calendar's sorted. Also, I've been thinking about her food and I'm pretty sure she's on the new chicken one now, not the salmon
she's been on the chicken one since august dan
Right. Good to know 😅
do you still have her blue brush at yours
Think so. I'll look Sat morning. I'm not making a scene of it
Rehearsal ran till 11 and I'm wrecked. Just saw the cricket. Four down in the first over, what
it's over dan. we're not chasing that. off to work
Found the brush. It was behind the bin. I'm not going to explain how
on break. don't put it in the bin again
Never again
still on for sat 8am or do you want me to bring her round tonight
Sat 8 is fine. I'll be up. I've set an alarm that plays the Pixies, it's a deterrent
dont make me come round and wake you dan
Wouldn't dream of it 🙂 Wet food at 7pm, it's in my phone with a bell
ok
